name: Featured Post Carousel by Tag
author: Daniel Esparza

sections.description:
Featured Post Carousel by Tag shows content (posts, pages, products and other custom post types) tagged with the slug “featured” or “destacado” in a responsive carousel powered by OwlCarousel2. Add the carousel with the shortcode [featured-post-carousel-tag]. In the plugin settings you choose which content types to include.

Main features:

  1. Shortcode [featured-post-carousel-tag] to show a carousel of items.
  2. Shows the featured image (links to the item), the title (links to the item) and a “Read more” button, or an add-to-cart button for products.
  3. Supports posts, pages, WooCommerce products and other custom post types.

Usage

Shortcode example:
[featured-post-carousel-tag per_page=”8″ items=”3″ autoplay=”true”]

Attributes:

  • per_page — number of items to query (default 8)
  • items — number of visible items on desktop (default 3)
  • autoplay — “true” or “false” (default “true”)

External services

This plugin bundles the official OwlCarousel 2.3.4 JavaScript file. The standard OwlCarousel distribution optionally contains code to support embedded videos from external providers (for example Vimeo or Vzaar), and in those specific setups it may request public thumbnails or metadata from those services.

Important:
The plugin does not use or enable these video features by default.
With the current plugin setup no requests are made to external services.
External requests would only happen if an administrator intentionally adds videos from those providers to a carousel.

Third-party libraries

  • OwlCarousel 2.3.4 — MIT — https://github.com/OwlCarousel2/OwlCarousel2
sections.faq:
Which tags does the plugin look for?

Tags with the slug featured or destacado in the taxonomies registered for the selected content types (for example post_tag, product_tag or non-hierarchical custom taxonomies).

My pages do not have tags. What can I do?

By default WordPress does not add tags or categories to pages. To enable them, add this code to the functions.php file of your theme or to a small plugin:

function fpct_enable_tags_for_pages() {
// Add post_tag to pages
register_taxonomy_for_object_type( ‘post_tag’, ‘page’ );
// Add category to pages
register_taxonomy_for_object_type( ‘category’, ‘page’ );
}
add_action( ‘init’, ‘fpct_enable_tags_for_pages’ );
sections.changelog:
1.1.0

  • Interface strings in English, ready for translation on translate.wordpress.org.
  • Removed the function_exists() wrappers and the “missing files” admin notice (the library files are included in the plugin).
  • Simplified the WooCommerce add-to-cart output inside the carousel.
  • Moved the inline style of the empty image placeholder to the stylesheet.
  • Plugin CSS and JS versions now follow the plugin version.
  • Readme: fixed the License URI format.
  • Plugin header: added Requires at least, Requires PHP and License URI.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
  • Shortcode [featured-post-carousel-tag].
  • Settings page in the admin.
  • Sanitization, escaping and caching following WordPress best practices.
